name: Peltagreave
description: Hold the plate forward as the outermost guard with the forearm braced behind it as a second layer.

name: Might Snapblock
description: Step so that plate and forearm and shoulder meet the foe's cut as three staggered lines.

name: Chimepelta
description: Rap the first stroke aside with the plate so the second finds an empty line.

name: Roundface Assault
description: Drive the braced elbow behind the plate into the foe's ribs as he closes.

name: Lightrim Fastness
description: Lay one sheath of qi over another across the plate so each cut must break two.

name: Murkpelta
description: Chain three raps each carrying more qi than the last until the foe's blade is thrown wide.

name: Hoarfrost Umbo
description: Raise qi in three bands across plate and arm and body so that no single blow reaches the flesh.

name: Parry Torment
description: Let a heavy cut break the outer layer and drive the stored qi of the inner layers back through the dome.

name: Restoring Edgeplate
description: Read the angle of a cut from the foe's wrist so the plate can meet it where it will rebound.

name: Thorn Smallface
description: Receive the cut square on the plate face so its force is gathered in one place.

name: Bucklerredge Cloak
description: Tap the rim into the oncoming blade to send it rebounding along its own path.

name: Silt Tuckin
description: Step back with the rebound of the parry to keep the plate between blade and body.

name: Dab Assault
description: Send the dome out in the rebound to rap the foe's blade hand.

name: Murk Knucklegrip
description: Sweep the plate against a cut and turn it so the blade crosses back over the foe's own front.

name: Punchboss Cloak
description: Hold a spring of qi in the plate so each blow bounces back the full weight it brought.

name: Blazeparry
description: Strike a moment after the parry along the same line so the reeling arm takes a second blow.

name: Verity Knucklegrip
description: Receive a heavy cut on the plate and send its whole force back along the blade into the foe's arm.

name: Enduring Waning Lightrim
description: Catch a thrust on the dome and turn the point back toward the foe's own shoulder.

name: Charter Centergrip
description: Hold the plate within the qi field so the field's edge thickens around it.

name: Torrent Nudge
description: Move through the qi field with the plate leading so the field keeps pace with the body.

name: Equipoise Armstrap
description: Rap a blade with the plate while the field softens the blow before it lands.

name: Granite Bucklerredge
description: Jab the dome out and let a pulse of field qi follow the strike.

name: Targecloak
description: Thicken the field in front of the plate until cuts slow as they enter it.

name: Gust Roundface
description: Knock the dome forward with the weight of the field stacked behind it.

name: Restoring Centergrip
description: Spread the field thin around the plate to feel blades and thrown darts by their disturbance.

name: Edgeplate Cloak
description: Press the field out from the plate in a broad curve that holds off several attackers at once.

name: Daybreak Snapblock
description: Release the stored field outward from the dome in a sudden burst that throws back everyone near.

name: Tempered Umbo
description: Rap the foe's guard hand hard enough to pop it open.

name: Might Punchblock
description: Drop the iron rim onto the foe's raised blade near the hilt.

name: Punchblock Maelstrom
description: Bash the whole plate face into the foe's shield or arm to knock it down.

name: Mantled Punchboss
description: Take a blow on the plate at the moment the foe's arm is fully extended.

name: Dab Leap
description: Step through the foe's guard as it opens and drive onward.

name: Chimeumbo
description: Parry an overhand cut at the foe's wrist so that his arm is thrown wide.

name: Granite Tuckin
description: Strike the dome against the foe's helm with qi that shakes the skull inside it.

name: Toxin Parry
description: Rap the foe's elbow with qi to force his arm open and leave his body bare.

name: Paralyzing Nudge
description: Bear qi through the plate onto a blade until it bends and the foe must let go.

name: Nudgebarrage
description: Smash the dome through the foe's raised guard with qi gathered for one decisive blow.

name: Mayhemtuckin
description: Sweep the heavy plate edge across a crowd with qi to knock down all within reach of the arm.

name: Iron Smallface
description: Stand with plate forward and blade back so the two hands answer each other without a word.

name: Gust Armstrap
description: Parry with the plate and let the blade follow the same line at once.

name: Sanguine Smallface
description: Lead with the dome so the foe watches it while the blade slips round.

name: Edgeplate Maelstrom
description: Thrust with the blade first and have the plate close the line behind it.

name: Might Punchboss
description: Move both feet in the same direction as the plate so hands and feet agree.

name: Centergrip Assault
description: Strike the foe's wrist with the rim as the blade cuts his other side.

name: Facettarge
description: Send qi along the plate arm and the sword arm on separate tracks so each guards the other.

name: Dabbarrage
description: Beat the foe's blade with the plate and cut at the same instant with the sword.

name: Roundface Fastness
description: Bind the foe's blade with the plate rim while the sword hand cuts the freed line.

name: Gustumbo
description: Back away with plate and blade crossing the foe's line in turn to turn every cut.

name: Targeplating
description: Cross plate and blade before the chest so qi on both forms a single guard against heavy blows.

name: Furrowing Snapblock
description: Take the foe's stroke on the plate and answer at once with a blade carrying the plate's stored qi.

name: Aegis Lightrim
description: Spread the arm wide behind the plate like a wing so the whole flank is covered.

name: Aegis Umbo
description: Drop low behind the plate like a hawk folding for a stoop and let the cut fly over.

name: Gust Bucklerredge
description: Rake the rim down the foe's arm in a short curved stroke like a talon.

name: Tuckin Pounce
description: Rise on the toes and step lightly in behind the plate as though lifted by an updraft.

name: Torrent Armstrap
description: Beat the plate out and back like a wingbeat so two cuts are turned in rapid time.

name: Remnant Knucklegrip
description: Let qi sharpen the eyes so the foe's smallest tell is seen behind the plate.

name: Thorntarge
description: Spread a qi shield from the plate over a companion standing at the holder's shoulder.

name: Granite Nudge
description: Drop from a leap with the dome leading so the whole falling weight strikes the foe's guard.

name: Immovable Centergrip
description: Hold the plate dished slightly toward the foe so blows are gathered into its hollow.

name: Enduring Edgeplate
description: Let qi pool in the plate's hollow until it holds every blow without spilling.

name: Peltapounce
description: Step low and smooth behind the plate as water finds its level.

name: Granite Dab
description: Skim the rim across the foe's guard hand in a flat quick arc.

name: Stifling Armstrap
description: Shove the hollow of the plate against the foe's blade arm to spoil his stroke.

name: Sanguine Tuckin
description: Release the blows pooled in the plate in one outward strike of the dome.

name: Implacable Umbo
description: Deepen the hollow with qi until cuts and thrusts sink into it and lose their bite.

name: Murkumbo
description: Parry so the blade is levelled and runs off the plate's lip like overflow.

name: Waningumbo
description: Fill the plate with the foe's own force and let it spill back through the rim in a sweeping cut.

name: Dominating Mayhem Smallface
description: Open a hollow field before the plate that draws a foe's strike off its target and into the plate.

name: Charter Lightrim
description: Curve the plate as a river bends so blows are turned along the arm instead of into it.

name: Siltparry
description: Step with the foe's cut as a stream goes round a stone and arrive at his flank.

name: Charter Punchboss
description: Set the feet like stones in a river bed and let the blow pass round the plate.

name: Scything Punchblock
description: Rap the rim down the foe's arm in a long flowing stroke.

name: Peltaplating
description: Split qi into two channels along the plate so one turns blows aside and one holds firm.

name: Suppressing Dab
description: Hook the rim over the foe's blade and carry it along the current into the ground.

name: Unbroken Roundface
description: Rap a cut downward and sideways so it runs off as if down a slope.

name: Glintpelta
description: Take a charge on the curved plate and turn its flood of force around the holder and into the foe.

name: Intent Parry
description: Join a parry along one channel and a dome strike along the other in one unbroken motion.

name: Implacable Bucklerredge
description: Stand with the plate to the wind and swear silently to hold the line against whatever comes.

name: Equipoise Knucklegrip
description: Turn the plate across the cut like a gust across a flame and bend the blade aside.

name: Gust Parry
description: Lean into a step as into a wind and keep the plate set at the leading shoulder.

name: Iron Nudge
description: Rap the foe's wrist with the rim in a sudden gusting stroke.

name: Thornpelta
description: Turn the shoulder as the wind turns and let the plate take the blow at a slant.

name: Murk Lightrim
description: Bring the plate back with a light hand after each parry as a gust falls and returns.

name: Punchboss Fastness
description: Hold qi in the plate steady as a sworn word so that no blow shakes the grip.

name: Thorn Roundface
description: Hook the rim on a blade and drag it with a qi gust that leaves the foe turning.

name: Cleaving Tuckin
description: Gather qi at the rim like a rising wind and release it in one hard slash across the guard.

name: Aegispelta
description: Throw qi out from the plate in a hard gale that bends cuts and thrown blades from their line.

name: Granite Umbo
description: Bring the dome down with a gale of qi that shatters the guard it meets.

name: Umbohauberk
description: Stand as at a plateau's edge with weight low and the plate held square to the drop of every cut.

name: Gust Centergrip
description: Rap the foe's blade from the plate rim to send it over the edge of the guard.

name: Tuckinjaunt
description: Step across open ground in a straight line with the plate leading and no cover on either hand.

name: Edgeplate Hauberk
description: Drop the plate like a cliff face between the foe's cut and the body.

name: Unmaking Dab
description: Punch along the line of the foe's blade edge so his own cut brings him onto the dome.

name: Knucklegrip Sprint
description: Hold the bearing as the feet move so the plate never turns from the foe.

name: Umbocuirass
description: Hold qi hard along the rim to guard the line at which the foe's blade must pass.

name: Fastening Nudge
description: Bind the blade at the rim and hold the line against every attempt to cross it.

name: Tempered Parry
description: Drop the qi-edged rim down the foe's arm in a raking cut that follows the cliff line.

name: Umbocloak
description: Turn a cut with a gust of qi from the rim that blows the blade wide.

name: Aegis Armstrap
description: Draw qi along the entire rim so the plate becomes a line that no cut can cross.

name: Adamant Knucklegrip
description: Let the foe's blow fall against the plate and throw its weight back along the line it came from.

name: Granite Roundface
description: Stand with the plate held open to the foe and the body behind it unhidden.

name: Annealed Smallface
description: Turn the plate on the held bearing so the blade is taken wherever it comes from.

name: Gusttarge
description: Walk straight toward the foe at an even pace behind an unwavering plate.

name: Blazepelta
description: Strike with the rim in a straight stroke that keeps its promise of direction.

name: Annealed Armstrap
description: Keep qi at the plate steady while the body advances through a hail of blows.

name: Gust Nudge
description: Punch the dome straight forward with qi at full spread before the foe can step out of line.

name: Thornumbo
description: Spread the plate's qi forward as a screen that moves with the holder and the companions who follow.

name: Veritypelta
description: Meet a heavy strike with the plate held open and return its force along the bearing it came on.

name: Granite Smallface
description: Hold the plate light and ready to turn with the strike as a vane turns in the gale.

name: Gustpelta
description: Whirl the plate once about the wrist to throw a heavy cut out of its line.

name: Careening Umbo
description: Spin on the heel to keep the plate facing the foe as he circles.

name: Blaze Dab
description: Rake the foe's guard with the rim at the end of a full turn.

name: Hoarfrost Lightrim
description: Turn the plate in a tight eddy that swallows a thrust and sends it past.

name: Facet Punchboss
description: Spiral qi around the plate so that blows are drawn into the turn and thrown off.

name: Iron Parry
description: Complete a turn with the dome and send the qi of the spiral into the foe's chest.

name: Chime Snapblock
description: Whip the rim around the foe's wrist with qi until the sword spins free.

name: Hoarfrost Edgeplate
description: Turn the plate in a storm of qi that rejects every blow aimed at the holder.

name: Wrecking Bucklerredge
description: Spin with the plate extended and carry the stored spiral outward to hit all foes in reach.
